Pree, it's ticket #8841. Tobias said in this channel yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27) that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841.

His message calls it his dealer account and doesn't say "Marrow Fieldworks" by name. I'm connecting the two because the January handoff note says Marrow Fieldworks moved off your book on Jan 5. If you want to be sure before the call, ask Tobias. Also, don't mix it up with #88412, which is the old Tansleigh Packaging Door 6 scanner ticket.
